seoTitle: Succession Test: Which Character Are You? (11 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Succession test: 11 everyday questions reveal whether you're Logan, Kendall, Roman, Shiv, Connor, Tom, Greg or Gerri — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the boss, the heir, or the cousin who keeps a copy of everything? Answer 11 everyday questions about family, money and power, and find out which Succession character you are.

characters.name: Logan Roy
characters.title: The Boss
characters.summary: Ruthless, shrewd and always in control. You built it, you run it and you're not letting go.
description: Like Logan, you're the one in charge. He's the billionaire founder of the media company Waystar RoyCo.
You don't let go. On his 80th birthday, Logan refuses to step aside, and he fights off every attempt to take his company.
You play to win. Logan sells Waystar to GoJo without asking his children first.
characters.flaw: You'd rather be feared than loved, even by your own family.
characters.signature: A cold stare, a short sentence and the final word.
characters.clashReason: they'd test your loyalty, then tell you that you failed

characters.name: Kendall Roy
characters.title: The Heir
characters.summary: Driven, insecure and always chasing approval. You want to prove yourself, and you go big trying.
description: Like Kendall, you want to prove yourself. He's Logan's second son, and for years he's seen as the heir.
You want approval more than anything. Kendall is business-savvy but insecure, and he's desperate for his father's respect.
You go big. Kendall turns on his father at a press conference, publicly linking him to the cruises scandal.
characters.flaw: You need everyone's approval, especially the one person who won't give it.
characters.signature: A big announcement, a nice jacket and a plan that's a bit too bold.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn your quiet chat into a grand announcement

characters.name: Roman Roy
characters.title: The Joker
characters.summary: Sharp, funny and allergic to taking anything seriously. You hide everything behind a joke.
description: Like Roman, you hide everything behind a joke. He's Logan's youngest son, and he becomes chief operating officer.
You avoid responsibility. Roman has sharp instincts, but he's immature, and he's always looking for his father's approval.
You feel more than you show. Roman breaks down while giving Logan's eulogy.
characters.flaw: You'd rather make a joke than admit how you feel.
characters.signature: A filthy joke, a smirk and feelings you'll never admit to.
characters.clashReason: they'd make a joke at your expense when you were trying to be serious

characters.name: Shiv Roy
characters.title: The Strategist
characters.summary: Smart, strategic and always playing the long game. You want the top job, and you're thinking three moves ahead.
description: Like Shiv, you're a strategist. She's Logan's only daughter, and she starts out working in politics.
You want the top job. Shiv is promised the CEO role, but she's sidelined again and again.
You make the final call. In the finale, Shiv casts the deciding vote that approves the sale of the company.
characters.flaw: You play the game so hard that you forget who's on your side.
characters.signature: A sharp suit, a hidden plan and a deal nobody saw coming.
characters.clashReason: they'd make a deal behind your back, and call it strategy

characters.name: Connor Roy
characters.title: The Dreamer
characters.summary: Cheerful, oblivious and full of big ideas. You dream big, whether or not anyone believes in you.
description: Like Connor, you dream big. He's Logan's eldest son, from his first marriage, and he stays out of the family business.
You don't let reality get in the way. Connor runs for president, first as an independent and then as a libertarian.
You land on your feet. Connor marries Willa, and he drops out of the race in exchange for a promised ambassadorship to Slovenia.
characters.flaw: You believe your own hype, even when nobody else does.
characters.signature: A campaign button, a grand plan and a speech nobody asked for.
characters.clashReason: they'd explain their big plan to you for an hour, twice

characters.name: Tom Wambsgans
characters.title: The Climber
characters.summary: Eager, ambitious and very good at sucking up. You know how to get close to power, and how to stay there.
description: Like Tom, you're ambitious. He's Shiv's husband, and he works his way up from Waystar's parks and cruises division to running ATN.
You know which side to pick. Tom betrays the Roy siblings by telling Logan about their plan.
You end up on top. In the finale, Tom is named CEO.
characters.flaw: You suck up to everyone above you and take it out on everyone below.
characters.signature: A big smile for the boss and a sharp word for the intern.
characters.clashReason: they'd be nice to your face, then throw you under the bus to impress the boss

characters.name: Greg Hirsch
characters.title: The Survivor
characters.summary: Awkward, nervous and much sneakier than you look. You stumble along, but somehow you always survive.
description: Like Greg, you're more awkward than you'd like. He's Logan's great-nephew, and he stumbles into a job at Waystar.
You're sneakier than you look. Greg secretly keeps copies of documents from the cruises scandal, and he uses them as leverage.
You always survive. After the sale, Tom keeps Greg on, because his mixed loyalty is useful.
characters.flaw: You'll go along with almost anything if it keeps you safe.
characters.signature: A nervous laugh, a borrowed suit and a few secret copies of everything.
characters.clashReason: they'd keep a copy of your secrets, just in case

characters.name: Gerri Kellman
characters.title: The Pro
characters.summary: Calm, shrewd and unflappable. You've seen it all, and you always protect yourself first.
description: Like Gerri, you're the most sensible person in the room. She's Waystar's general counsel, and Shiv's godmother.
You step up when you're needed. Gerri becomes acting CEO when Logan steps back.
You look after yourself. When Roman fires her, Gerri negotiates a hefty severance deal.
characters.flaw: You'd rather protect yourself than stick your neck out for anyone.
characters.signature: A raised eyebrow, a dry comment and an exit plan.
characters.clashReason: they'd shut down your idea with one dry sentence

questions.text: Your family is planning a big birthday dinner. You...

options.text: Decide who sits where, and who doesn't get invited
Plan a huge gesture that's a little too much
Show up late, and leave early
Hope someone remembers to invite you

questions.text: Your boss asks you to do something you're not sure is right. You...

options.text: Do it, then quietly keep a copy of everything
Do it, and make sure they know how loyal you are
Ask what's in it for you first
Get it in writing, so you're covered

questions.text: There's nothing on your calendar this weekend. You...

options.text: Work on a comeback plan nobody asked for
Spend it on a passion project nobody else gets
Stay in bed, sending sarcastic texts
Do something quiet and civilized, with your phone off

questions.text: You start a new job and don't know anyone. You...

options.text: Laugh nervously, and try very hard not to break anything
Get in with the boss, fast
Make it clear on day one that you're not to be messed with
Keep your head down, and learn how everything really works

questions.text: Someone criticizes you in front of everyone. You...

options.text: Hit back with a joke so harsh the room goes quiet
Say nothing, and remember it forever
Get defensive, then spiral about it later
Don't notice. You thought they were complimenting you

questions.text: A colleague lands the job you were going for. You...

options.text: Congratulate them, then start planning your next move
Congratulate them, a little too much
Pretend you never wanted it anyway
Ask if there's a job for you on their new team

questions.text: You get a chance to make a lot of money, but someone will get hurt. You...

options.text: Take it. That's business
Weigh it up calmly, and decide it's not worth the risk
Feel terrible, then take it anyway
Miss your chance, because you weren't paying attention

questions.text: You're asked to give a speech at a family event. You...

options.text: Plan to make jokes, then get emotional halfway through
Turn it into a pitch for your big plans
Give a polished speech that makes you look good
Try something bold and unexpected that goes badly wrong

questions.text: Someone you rely on lets you down. You...

options.text: Cut them off. You don't do second chances
Forgive them, but bring it up in every argument from now on
Act like it's fine, then take it out on someone else
Shrug. You expected it

questions.text: You're one of four siblings fighting to take over your father's media empire. You...

options.text: Plan a dramatic takeover, and announce it at a press conference
Say you don't care who wins, and secretly care a lot
Make a deal behind everyone's back
Run for president instead

questions.text: You're the outsider in a rich, powerful family that looks down on you. You...

options.text: Smile, take it and keep climbing until they need you
Laugh at all their jokes, and hope they keep you around
Make yourself impossible to replace
Build your own empire, and make them come to you
